subject: RP5 Q14 radio options are objects not strings (schema variant)
body: During test 2027, discovered that retake-practice-5.json Q14 has radio options as [{value,text}] objects rather than plain strings. This is a schema inconsistency vs other radio inputs. All other radio/dropdown answers are plain strings. Current answer C is valid (matches option.value). No user-visible bug -- the test was fixed to handle both forms. GI: consider normalizing radio options to plain strings in RP5 Q14 for schema consistency, or document this as an intentional variant.
